original_test_intent: Verify each SMBIOS Type 9 Slot ID raw value follows the platform's bus-type-specific numbering policy, uniquely and stably identifies the intended slot where uniqueness is required, and persists after reboot.
original_method: Collect complete raw/decoded Type 9 records, retain the Slot ID bytes with slot type, designation, handle and supported segment/bus/device/function fields, compare to the approved platform numbering map, then repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the Slot ID semantics/map and reboot plan. No physical card or addressing change is required.
required_inputs: Expected raw Slot ID per exact Type 9 record
Rules for zero, duplicate, reserved or intentionally reused IDs
Validated parser plus approved reboot/OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS and optional read-only PCI queries; do not modify PCI addressing, firmware or card population.
Preserve raw Slot ID bytes and slot type because interpretation can be bus-type-specific.
Do not treat Slot ID as a PCI domain, bus number or BDF without an explicit platform mapping; Type 9 has separate bus-address fields where implemented.
Evaluate duplicates against policy rather than assuming global uniqueness across unrelated bus types or containers.
Stop on ambiguous interpretation, unexpected duplicate/change or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Extract raw Slot ID with complete Type 9 identity, apply the approved bus-specific numbering/uniqueness rules and compare the map before/after reboot.
Do not alter PCI topology or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve Slot ID semantics, topology mapping and allowed duplicate/zero cases.
Approve reboot/recovery, resolve any ID-versus-PCI-address ambiguity and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The text target is relevant, but grep omits the raw value, slot type and separate bus-address context needed to interpret the ID and detect incorrect duplication.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 9 records and validate Slot ID bytes per exact slot and bus-type policy, separately correlating supported segment/bus/device/function fields.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Slot ID scope, Type 9 script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Compare raw Slot ID values against a topology- and bus-type-aware numbering map, test the intended uniqueness domain and retain separate Type 9 bus-address data for PCI correlation.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 9 slots across supported system bus types.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS, board/riser and parser versions plus availability of extended bus-address fields.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 9 Slot ID semantics, approved platform slot-numbering map and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw-value provenance, explicit uniqueness domain and separation from PCI addressing.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; detects duplicate/misassigned IDs without incorrectly requiring them to equal OS PCI addresses.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Bus-specific ID interpretation, topology map and zero/duplicate policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Slot ID alone may not be globally unique or sufficient for OS-device correlation.

project_override_considerations: A project may permit repeated or zero IDs only when its bus-specific platform policy documents them; the override must not erase the separate designation and bus-address identity evidence.
expected_evidence: Approved board/riser topology, bus-specific Slot ID map, uniqueness domain and exception policy
Complete pre-reboot Type 9 records with handle, designation, slot type, raw/decoded Slot ID and supported segment/bus/device/function fields
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot record diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently targets Slot ID correctness and persistence and does not equate it to a PCI address.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The raw ID is safely readable; platform numbering semantics are required inputs rather than an irreducible source ambiguity.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw bytes, bus-specific meaning, uniqueness domain and separate PCI-address correlation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains numbering/map safeguards while correcting the metadata case to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Missing maps and engineer verdict remain readiness/governance states instead of lowering capability.

review_improvement: Prevents treating Slot ID as an OS BDF and prevents an arbitrary global-uniqueness check from rejecting valid bus-scoped identifiers.
independent_technical_reasoning: Slot ID is a structured Type 9 value whose collection and policy-based identity checks are deterministic software operations once its platform semantics are defined.
